text: Steep pavment entrance: Subject: Formal Request for Remedial Works to Pavement and Road Level at Driveway Entrance Dear Sir/Madam, I am writing to raise a concern regarding the sudden drop in level between the pavement and the street outside my property at 46 Dunblane Road, SE96RS, where the entrance to my driveway meets the road. I would also be grateful for written confirmation of any proposed action and the expected timescale for addressing this issue. Thank you for your time and consideration. text: Summergates lane: I am writing to raise a formal complaint about the extremely poor and dangerous condition of the road through our village. The road has deteriorated to such an extent that it poses a serious risk to motorists and other road users. The surface is badly damaged, making it difficult to navigate safely, and the condition of the road has already caused damage to my car. This is completely unacceptable. Residents should not have to risk damaging their vehicles or put their safety at risk simply by using the road to travel around their own village. My concerns are particularly serious because, when other roads are closed, this road can become the only route in and out of the village. In these circumstances, there is no alternative route for residents, leaving them with no choice but to use a road that is in a dangerous condition. I am also extremely concerned about the elderly residents who use this road. They should not have to face the risk of accidents, injury or difficulty travelling because of the poor state of the highway. The situation is especially worrying for anyone who may need access for medical appointments, emergency services or essential journeys. I would like to know why the road has been allowed to deteriorate to this extent and what action Lincolnshire County Council intends to take to address the problem. I am requesting: ● An urgent inspection of the road to assess the extent of the damage and the safety risks. ● Immediate action to make the road safe for all users. ● A clear timescale for carrying out the necessary repairs. ● An explanation of what provision is being made for residents when this road is the only available route into or out of the village. I would appreciate this complaint being treated seriously and urgently. This is not simply a matter of an unsightly or poorly maintained road; it is a matter of public safety, access for village residents and the risk of further vehicle damage or a potentially serious accident.
